name: Helm Charts and Release Management
certifications: No official Helm certification; assessed by charts, tests and release pipelines
Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) covers Helm use
Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineer (CNPE) covers GitOps delivery with Helm

beginner.summary: For developers and operations engineers who deploy applications to Kubernetes and want to package them with Helm. Covers charts, releases and repositories, installing, upgrading and rolling back releases, public charts and OCI registries, values, chart structure, Go templates and Sprig functions, control flow, named templates, built-in objects, dependencies, hooks and tests, debugging templates, values schemas, packaging and publishing, secrets, server-side apply and readiness in Helm 4 and Helm in CI pipelines.
prerequisites: Deploys applications to Kubernetes with kubectl and YAML
Understands Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps and Secrets
outcomes: Install, upgrade and roll back releases with public and private charts
Write charts with templates, helpers, dependencies, hooks and value schemas
Debug, test, package and publish charts to OCI registries
Deploy charts from CI pipelines with Helm 4 behaviour such as server-side apply

subtopics: Why plain YAML gets hard to manage
What Helm does: package, configure and release

intermediate.summary: For engineers who maintain charts used by several teams or environments. Covers chart design patterns, library charts, umbrella charts, chart testing with ct and helm-unittest, environment values, Helmfile, GitOps with Argo CD and Flux, post-rendering with Kustomize, Helm 4 plugins, safe chart upgrades, CRDs and operators, secure defaults, chart signing, documentation, release strategies, multi-cluster and managed Kubernetes deployments, migrating from Helm 3 and troubleshooting failed releases.
prerequisites: Writes charts with templates, helpers, dependencies and hooks
outcomes: Design reusable, tested and documented charts and chart libraries
Deliver charts across environments and clusters with Helmfile and GitOps
Ship charts with secure defaults, signatures and safe upgrade paths
Migrate to Helm 4 and troubleshoot failed releases

advanced.summary: For platform engineers who run Helm-based delivery for an organisation. Covers golden chart strategy, internal chart catalogues, policy as code for charts, supply chain security, advanced templating, writing plugins, the Helm SDK, Helm-based operators, large-scale release management with ApplicationSets, server-side apply ownership at scale, release storage, performance of large charts, multi-tenant clusters, compliance and audit, disaster recovery, alternatives such as Kustomize and Timoni, contributing upstream, governing third-party charts and troubleshooting complex deployments.
prerequisites: Maintains chart libraries and GitOps delivery for several teams
outcomes: Set chart standards and run an internal chart catalogue for many teams
Secure and govern charts with policies, signatures and supply chain checks
Extend Helm with plugins, the SDK and operators
Operate Helm delivery at scale with good recovery, performance and auditability
